description: This file declares functions related to tensor conversion and memory handling within the Torch library's AOT (Ahead-Of-Time) Inductor component. It provides interfaces for allocating and managing tensor handles, emphasizing safety restrictions on usage within certain shared objects.

methods.name: unsafe_alloc_new_handles_from_tensors
methods.description: Allocates new tensor handles from a vector of tensors, returning a vector of AtenTensorHandle pointers. Intended for use outside model.so, not safe within model.so.

methods.name: alloc_tensors_by_stealing_from_handles
methods.description: Creates tensors by stealing from existing handles, only modifying the handles and not the original array. Not allowed to be called in model.so.
